context_type: DASHBOARDS & ADMIN PANELS + CITIZEN/EMPLOYER INTERACTIVE FLOWS

theme_strategy.rationale: Indian government portals and civic decision-makers demand clean, paper-credible, crisp clarity. High readability in high-ambient offices with zero visual fatigue.
theme_strategy.theme_support: Clean crisp light default with subtle warm stone backdrop + dark mode capability.

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

rules.H1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
rules.caption: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

layout_and_grids.mode: MODE B: High Density Civic Data Grid
layout_and_grids.container_padding: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 sm:py-8
layout_and_grids.kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
layout_and_grids.card_styling: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 shadow-sm hover:shadow transition-shadow p-5 sm:p-6
layout_and_grids.header_styling: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 shadow-xs

components_structure.Navbar: Top navigation with Emblem/SkillTrace logo, Role badge switcher (Admin, District Officer, Training Provider), Quick stats pill, User Avatar & Logout
components_structure.AuthLogin: Government/Provider dual login screen with demo 1-click role switcher (Admin, District, Provider) for instant evaluation
components_structure.ProviderDashboard: Trainees list with real-time confidence scores, 'Enroll New Trainee' modal with Consent signature/duplicate fuzzy AI detector, 'At-Risk Trainees' AI panel, 'Run Follow-Up Batch' simulator trigger
components_structure.DistrictAdminDashboard: Comprehensive filters (District, Sector, Course, Gender, Date Range), Recharts charts (Placement rate by Provider, Wage distribution, Non-placement reasons donut, District ranking table, Confidence breakdown)
components_structure.TraineeProfileJourney: Single Trainee 360 view: Enrollment -> Training -> 1mo -> 3mo -> 6mo -> 12mo longitudinal timeline with employer confirmation stamp and wage progression curve
components_structure.WhatsAppMessagingSimulator: Interactive WhatsApp chat simulator showcasing AI automated follow-up at 3mo/6mo, structured quick-response chips + natural Hindi/Hinglish/English free-text classification with sentiment & confidence tagging
components_structure.PublicEmployerVerify: Lightweight /verify/:token micro-page with zero friction for employers (1-click 'Confirm Employment', designation & wage bracket check, no password needed)
components_structure.ConsentDuplicateModal: Consent proof audit viewer and Fuzzy Matching duplicate resolver (showing matching Aadhaar hash / Phone / Name match %)

civic_emblem_bg.description: Grand administrative heritage building with sandstone columns

trainee_demo_avatar_1.description: Young Indian professional at workplace desk

trainee_demo_avatar_2.description: Young Indian developer / technician with spectacles

testing_attributes_contract.rule: Every interactive button, input, tab, filter, modal trigger, table row, and metric card MUST have a specific 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.clarity_over_flash: Prioritize high-density data tables, clear filters, explainable AI tooltips, and seamless state changes. Judges need to see the longitudinal tracking story instantly.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_hidden_missing_data: SkillTrace AI core thesis is honest data transparency. Always display verified vs self-reported vs unreachable with clear color-coded indicators.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.recharts_configuration: Use ResponsiveContainer, CartesianGrid with strokeDasharray='3 3' stroke='#E2E8F0', custom Tooltip styled with bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-md p-2, Legend with rounded icon type.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.interactive_whatsapp: The WhatsApp simulation should feel live: allow typing free-form answers (e.g., 'haan job lag gayi 18k salary TCS me' or 'No looking for work') which triggers the mock ML classifier showing Intent, Extracted Wage, and Confidence Score.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.seamless_mock_mode: All flows (enrollment, duplicate detection, AI follow-up dispatch, verification link click, report export) must function end-to-end without page crashes.
